# The initial generated PATCH request carries a typed User body

The initial Patch<'a> stores User<'a> and its borrowing build method clones that value into Request<User<'a>>. Emitting Method::PATCH does not serialize JSON, set Content-Type, send the request or decode a response. The generator also preserves a separate unit-body path for GET. At the fixed accepted revision, the API has evolved to OperationBody<User> and a consuming build_request that serializes bytes and returns Result; that later contract must not be projected onto the initial landing.

Scope: Graph API PATCH generation.
